versions.changelog: DEPRECATED — this skill was renamed to ibkr-options-assistant. Install that skill instead. No further updates here; this slug remains only as a redirect. Same code, same scripts — only the package name changed.
Docs only: new Security Model section in README (EN + 中文) — what the toolkit can do, trust boundaries (Gateway login + trade.py dual gates), output data handling, recommended setup. No code changes.

Security: alerts_monitor.py replaces eval() with an AST-walking evaluator whitelist (parse-time rejection of attribute access, calls outside abs/min/max/round, lambdas, comprehensions). All documented conditions continue to work; injection attempts are refused with ValueError.

trade.py extended-hours routing: auto-detects US/Eastern RTH (09:30–16:00 weekdays), with explicit --outside-rth/--rth-only overrides. Without this, off-hours orders sat on IBKR's gateway until next RTH open. Applies to all 5 order subcommands.

Major release: trade.py (opt-in dual-gate order execution), cost_basis.py (premium-adjusted), concentration.py (HHI/sector), flex_import.py, full English normalization of all scripts, bilingual README, 500-line options strategy operational reference (McMillan/Overby/Natenberg/Sinclair). Bug fixes: wheel annualized math, risk_sim 30% concentration threshold, CLI syntax docs.

Add Operations Guide: how to run 24/7 reliably — second user (avoids mobile app kicking Gateway), launchd/systemd auto-restart, and what to do when IBKR's ushmds historical-data farm has an outage (Warning 2105).
Add comprehensive IBKR market data subscription guide in README. Documents per-feature requirements (e.g. Greeks need OPRA + underlying), recommended bundles, costs, and commission-waiver thresholds.
Default to market_data_type=3 (smart auto-upgrade). Avoids Error 10089 on instruments without subscription while still using realtime data when available.
Rewrite SKILL.md for better readability on ClawHub web view — workflows now use compact tables instead of ASCII command graphs.
Initial release: 11 IBKR CLI scripts for options analysis, portfolio Greeks, P&L analytics, Wheel tracking, earnings warnings, and risk simulation. Read-only by design.
